story_type: flooded neighborhood, airboats hand residents to Guard high water trucks
hook: A whole Florida neighborhood under water, today.
narration: Floodwater filled this whole neighborhood in Cocoa, Florida.
Florida Army National Guard soldiers drove in on high water trucks.
These trucks ride so high that water flows under the cab, where a car would stall.
Airboats went house to house along the flooded streets.
At one home, crews helped a resident out to a waiting airboat.
Then the airboats carried people out to the trucks.
outcome: The soldiers evacuated residents from the flooded streets.
title: Airboats go house to house in a flood
description:
Florida Army National Guard soldiers with Bravo Battery, 1st Battalion, 260th Air Defense Artillery Regiment run high water rescue missions in Cocoa, Florida, on Nov. 20, 2026, evacuating residents caught in severe flooding.
